scope: DEV diagnostic only; non-newcomer eval races; no validation/OOS opened

reproduction.note: Reconstructed v4/v5 from original scripts and leakage-safe DEV files before contribution analysis.

root_cause_finding: The middle-market-rank probability compression is primarily generated by the market recalibration architecture (log market probability passed through logistic calibration and race-level renormalization), not by the newly added v4/v5 historical features.

feature_layer_notes.v4: Historical horse features add some average DEV improvement beyond recalibration, but the candidate still failed the preregistered stability gate; correlated all-history vs last5 finish-vs-market-rank terms have opposing coefficients and should not be tuned post hoc.
feature_layer_notes.v5: Recency-transition features add almost no mean winner-logloss improvement beyond the market recalibration component in this diagnostic; they are not the main source of rank compression.

draft_candidates: direct-market-preserving residual correction: log p_candidate = log p_market + bounded residual, followed by race normalization
uncertainty-adaptive residual shrinkage toward zero using only preregistered pre-race market uncertainty
explicit constraint that candidate correction cannot systematically flatten market rank distribution without DEV gate evidence
decision.reason: Race-time Snapshot Gate v4 real forward provenance still required before a new executable DEV trial; until then design and forward shadow diagnostics only.
